preview.text: Namibia and United Arab Emirates meet in a one-day match at Grand Prairie Stadium, where 13 previous one-day encounters show two wins for Namibia and 11 for United Arab Emirates. Namibia won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees, with a usual first-innings score of 220 in the six recorded one-day matches at this venue.

summary.text: Namibia defeated UAE by 8 wkts after restricting them to 134-10, with JJ Smit taking 4 for 29 and Tanish Suri scoring 29 off 22 balls as top scorer for UAE. Namibia then chased the target with 135-2, led by Michael van Lingen who was the top scorer with 71 off 83 balls against Ali Naseer who took 1 for 29.
